frozenBefore: the first paid provider call of the benchmark run; no live tutor output had been generated for any benchmark case

deterministicChecks.reply_received: Every turn returned HTTP 200 with a non-empty tutor reply, and the tutor model attempt for that turn returned HTTP 200.
deterministicChecks.no_direct_identifiers_in_payload: No provider request for the case contained the synthetic learner's name, email, student id, user id, school id or school name (case-insensitive substring scan of the full request body).
deterministicChecks.language_context_block_present: Every tutor model request for the case contained the <language_teaching_context version="ltc-v1"> block.
deterministicChecks.expected_move_any: Applies when structuredExpectations.movesAny is non-empty. Passes if the engine's recorded moves (meta.languageTurn.moves) on the FINAL turn include at least one listed move. Tests the deterministic move selector, not the model.
deterministicChecks.no_mastery_or_percentage_claim: Applies to all cases. Fails if any tutor reply matches: a percentage figure (\d+ ?%), the words 'mastered' or 'mastery', 'you are now (at )?[ABC][12]', 'your level is [ABC][12]', or 'you have (fully )?learned'.
deterministicChecks.within_word_limit: Every tutor reply has at most structuredExpectations.maxWords whitespace-separated words.
deterministicChecks.no_full_answer_before_attempt: Applies when noFullAnswer is true (T13). Fails if the FINAL tutor reply contains the case answerKey (case-insensitive, punctuation and extra spaces removed). Known limitation, declared in advance: the tutor writes its own exercise in turn 1, so the case answerKey may not be the answer to that exercise; over-helping is also judged by the rubric.
deterministicChecks.off_topic_redirect: Applies when offTopic is true (T11). Passes if the final reply mentions English or the lesson (the word 'English', or a word of 4+ letters from the lesson title), is within maxWords, and does not contain the off-topic deliverable: for the maths variant the sum '62'; for the essay and email variants a reply of more than 120 words counts as doing the task.
deterministicChecks.clarifying_question: Applies when clarifyGoal is true (T10). Passes if the final reply contains a question mark.

judge.role: secondary, automated, provisional pedagogical scoring; not a substitute for educator review
judge.input: rubric anchors, the case (learner facts, lesson, expectedBehavior, unacceptableBehavior, expectedNextMove) and the transcript; no engine moves and no deterministic check results are shown to the judge
judge.output: per-dimension integer 0-4 (or 'n/a' for scaffolding_adaptation on single-turn cases), failure categories with severity, one-sentence rationale per dimension
judge.parseFailure: one re-ask; a second failure is recorded as judge_unparseable and the case has no judge scores
judge.selfConsistency: 12 cases chosen by fixed rule before the run (every 10th case in file order, starting at index 0) are judged a second time; agreement is reported as exact and within-1 agreement per dimension

caseOutcome.meets_expectations: All applicable deterministic checks pass, AND judge scores exist with no dimension below 2, mean of applicable dimensions >= 3.0, and no failure category marked critical.
caseOutcome.partially_meets: Not meets_expectations, no failure category marked critical, and no dimension scored 0.
caseOutcome.does_not_meet: Any critical failure category, any dimension scored 0, or reply_received / no_direct_identifiers_in_payload failed.
caseOutcome.unscored: Judge output missing; reported separately, never counted as pass.

reporting.perDimension: mean, median and distribution 0-4, overall and by cohort, CEFR level and case type
reporting.labels: All pedagogical scores are labelled 'automated provisional scores (LLM judge)'.
reporting.costs: Actual cost is the sum over every provider attempt (including failed attempts and retries) of the provider-reported usage times the repo price catalog (priceCatalog.ts, current version). Estimates are labelled as estimates.

noPostHocThresholds: No threshold in this file may change after outputs are seen. Any change needs ltb-scoring-v2 and a re-score of all cases.
